title: The dimension of a space is the supremum of its local dimensions
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space. For $x\in X$ let $\dim_xX$ be the Krull dimension of $X$ at $x$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], and let $\dim X\in\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$ be the Krull dimension of $X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then $\dim X=\sup_{x\in X}\dim_xX$, the supremum taken in $\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$ (equal to $-\infty$ when $X$ is empty).

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 0B7I (lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions, line 1428); tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags (0B7I,topology-lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions)

proof.text: ($\sup_x\dim_xX\le\dim X$.) Let $x\in X$. The whole space $X$ is an open neighbourhood of $x$, and $X$ with the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology] induced from itself is $X$; so $X$ is one of the open neighbourhoods $U$ over which the minimum defining $\dim_xX$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is taken, whence $\dim_xX\le\dim X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Taking the supremum over $x\in X$ gives $\sup_{x\in X}\dim_xX\le\dim X$ (if $X=\emptyset$ the supremum is $-\infty$ and this is trivial). (Stacks argues with $\dim U'\le\dim U$ for opens $U'\subseteq U$, the remark after Definition 0055; taking $U=X$ needs only the definition.)

source.place: Topology, proof of Lemma Tag 0B7I (lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions, line 1428), lines 1433-1436 ('It is clear that dim(X) >= dim_x(X) ...'), with the remark after Definition Tag 0055 (definition-Krull, line 1392)

proof.text: (Reduction of $\dim X\le\sup_x\dim_xX$ to chains.) If $X=\emptyset$ then $\dim X=-\infty$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] and there is nothing to prove. Otherwise $\dim X$ is the supremum of the lengths $n\ge0$ of chains of irreducible closed subsets of $X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], so it suffices to show: for every chain $Z_0\subsetneq Z_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_n$ of irreducible closed subsets of $X$ there is a point $x\in X$ with $\dim_xX\ge n$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]; then every such $n$ is $\le\sup_x\dim_xX$, and hence so is their supremum $\dim X$.

source.place: Topology, proof of Lemma Tag 0B7I (lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions, line 1428), lines 1437-1439 ('For the converse, let n >= 0 and suppose that dim(X) >= n ...')

proof.text: (The chain restricted to a neighbourhood of a point of $Z_0$.) Let $Z_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_n$ be as in step 2. $Z_0$ is irreducible, hence nonempty [def-weil-irreducible-components]; pick $x\in Z_0$. Let $U$ be any open neighbourhood of $x$ in $X$, with the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Since $x\in Z_0\subseteq Z_i$ we have $x\in Z_i\cap U$, so every $Z_i$ is an irreducible closed subset of $X$ meeting $U$. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-subspace-irreducible-closed-correspondence] each $Z_i\cap U$ is an irreducible closed subset of $U$, and $Z_i\subsetneq Z_{i+1}$ gives $Z_i\cap U\subsetneq Z_{i+1}\cap U$ (the source's hint: the closure of $U\cap Z_i$ in $X$ is $Z_i$, so equal intersections would give equal $Z_i$). Thus $Z_0\cap U\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_n\cap U$ is a chain of irreducible closed subsets of $U$ of length $n$, and $\dim U\ge n$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].

source.place: Topology, proof of Lemma Tag 0B7I (lemma-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions, line 1428), lines 1439-1446 ('Pick x in Z_0. For every open neighbourhood U of x we get a chain ... details omitted; hint: the closure of U cap Z_i is Z_i')

proof.text: (Conclusion.) By step 3, $\dim U\ge n$ for every open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$, so the minimum $\dim_xX$ of these dimensions [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is $\ge n$. This is what step 2 requires, so $\dim X\le\sup_x\dim_xX$; with step 1, $\dim X=\sup_{x\in X}\dim_xX$.

The definitions def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point (min over open neighbourhoods) and def-kun-topological-krull-dimension (Mathlib leaf topologicalKrullDim) agree with 0055 (3)-(4). Proof written in four steps following the proof of 0B7I: (1) dim_x X <= dim X by taking U = X in the minimum (Stacks' monotonicity remark is not needed); (2) reduction to chains; (3) a chain Z_0 ... Z_n and x in Z_0 give for every open U containing x the chain Z_i cap U in U, the 'details omitted' of the source carried by the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-open-subspace-irreducible-closed-correspondence (TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds.orderIsoOfIsOpenEmbedding, Mathlib/Topology/Sets/Closeds.lean:515); (4) conclusion. Mathlib has no local Krull dimension of a topological space and no supremum formula (searches recorded); the source repository's topologicalKrullDimAt is not Mathlib.
